title: AckOnErrorReceiver.bitmaps array limits M to 2 bits maximum
description:
## Location
- /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/fragment/ack_on_error.rs line 660

## Problem
```rust
/// Bitmap of received tiles per window.
/// Index 0 = window 0, etc.
bitmaps: [u64; 4], // Up to 4 windows (M=2)
```

The bitmap array is fixed at 4 elements, supporting M values 0, 1, or 2 (1, 2, or 4 windows respectively).

If a user specifies M=3 (8 windows) or higher, the receiver will panic with out-of-bounds access when accessing `bitmaps[window]` for window >= 4.

## API Risk
The const generic M is accepted but not validated against the internal array size. Users get runtime panics instead of compile-time errors.

## Suggested Fix
1. Add compile-time assertion: `const _: () = assert!(M <= 2);`
2. Or make array size derived from M: `bitmaps: [u64; 1 << M]` (requires const generic feature)
3. Document the M <= 2 limitation in the type's documentation
